deals.sector: Danish enterprise infrastructure layer
deals.note: Velatir , a Danish enterprise infrastructure layer, raised €5m led by Spintop Ventures and Ugly Duckling Ventures , with Norrsken Evolve participating.
Agellus Capital acquired Phillips Fire & Life Safety , a Houston-based fire and life safety services company, adding it to Bluejack Fire & Life Safety.

deals.sector: Huron Capital portfolio company
deals.note: Albireo Energy , a Huron Capital portfolio company, acquired Powers ' regional units in Oklahoma and Mississippi/Louisiana.
Aventia , backed by Bernhard Capital Partners , acquired Bryant Hammett & Associates , a Ferriday, La.-based civil engineering, land surveying and hazard mitigation firm.

deals.company: Charlesbank is in talks for a $700m stake in U.S. law firm WSHB
deals.note: Charlesbank is in talks for a $700m stake in U.S. law firm WSHB , per the FT.
The Crest Group , backed by Stellex Capital Management , acquired Dukane , a St. Charles, Ill.-based maker of ultrasonic solutions and plastic joining technologies.

deals.sector: U.K
deals.note: CVC Capital Partners invested in OpenRent , a U.K. property rental platform.

deals.sector: Apax Partners portfolio company
deals.note: Foods Connected , an Apax Partners portfolio company, acquired food quality inspection provider HarvestMark Quality Insights .
Genstar Capital agreed to buy Oncourse Home Solutions , a Naperville, Ill.-based provider of home infrastructure warranties, from Apax Partners .
Investcorp acquired Indian contract logistics platform 20Cube 3PL Solutions for about $52m.

deals.sector: Irish occupational health provider
deals.note: Medmark , an Irish occupational health provider, secured up to €70m from Phoenix Equity Partners .
Security Fire Solutions Platform , backed by Blackford Capital , acquired Industrial Electronic Systems , a Rancho Cordova, Calif.-based provider of fire alarm, security, and life safety solutions.
SEVA Growth invested in Serif Health , an SF-based provider of healthcare price transparency data.

deals.sector: SF-based data management platform valued by VCs at $3.5b
deals.note: Cribl , an SF-based data management platform valued by VCs at $3.5b, acquired the security operations platform of Radiant Security , which has raised $22m from Cheyenne Partners, N47, Lightspeed Venture Partners Israel, Jibe Ventures, General Advance, Uncorrelated Ventures, and Acrew Capital.

deals.sector: Israeli cyber insurance and services startup, for $575m
deals.note: Munich Re agreed to acquire At-Bay , an Israeli cyber insurance and services startup, for $575m. At-Bay had raised over $290m from Lightspeed, Khosla Ventures, M12, Acrew Capital, RPS Ventures, Icon Ventures, and Samsung Venture Investment.
Quantum Capital Group agreed to sell Permian Basin-focused FireBird Energy II to Continental Resources .
Strategic Value Partners hired JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley to find a buyer for APCOA Parking , a London-based parking space operator that could fetch €2b, per Bloomberg.
Academic Capital Partners is raising $300m for a debut fund that will buy educational assets in Asia and the Middle East.

deals.sector: new cybersecurity VC firm led by ex-CrowdStrike CTO Elia Zaitsev
deals.note: Cognition , a new cybersecurity VC firm led by ex-CrowdStrike CTO Elia Zaitsev, is raising $170m for its debut fund, per Axios.
Jefferies Credit Partners is targeting €1b for a secondaries fund, per Bloomberg.

deals.sector: early-stage entertainment VC firm
deals.note: Makers Fund , an early-stage entertainment VC firm, raised $250m for its fourth fund.

deals.company: Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena
deals.note: Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena has offered to buy rival Italian lenders Banco BPM and Banca Generali for a combined €34 billion in stock.

deals.sector: "de-extinction" startup
deals.note: Colossal , the "de-extinction" startup, is raising new funding at a valuation of at least $23b, per Axios Pro .

deals.sector: urban primary care provider
deals.note: Cityblock , an urban primary care provider, raised $116m in Series E funding from insider General Catalyst . It also completed its all-stock acquisition of rural primary care business Homeward Health, whose backers included GC, Arch Venture Partners, and Human Capital.

deals.sector: 3D content creation platform
deals.note: Math Magic , a Beijing-based 3D creation platform, raised $50m. BAI Capital and HyT Capital led, joined by V Fund and insiders HSG, IDG Capital, Long-Z Investments, Crystal Stream, and Jinqiu Capital.

deals.sector: NYC-based biotech whose lead candidate focuses on Parkinson's disease
deals.note: Remepy , an NYC-based biotech whose lead candidate focuses on Parkinson's disease, raised $36m in Series A funding. O.G. Venture Partners and M Ventures led, joined by NFX, Vine Ventures, Qumra Capital, and TechAviv.

deals.sector: pressurized-water nuclear reactors
deals.note: Apollo Atomics , an MIT spinoff building pressurized water reactors, raised $31m in seed funding. FCVC led, joined by YC, Telesoft Partners, Alumni Ventures, Robinhood Ventures, Nucleation Capital, Pelion VC, and Duke Capital Partners.

deals.sector: New Zealand maker of electric hydrofoil boats
deals.note: Vessev , a New Zealand maker of electric hydrofoil boats, raised US$19m in Series A funding, per Axios Pro. Blackbird Ventures led, joined by GD1, Rypples, K1W1, Icehouse Ventures, Shasta Ventures, and NZVC.

deals.sector: Swedish platform for mapping molecular cell architecture
deals.note: Pixelgen Technologies , a Swedish platform for mapping molecular cell architecture, raised $15.5m in Series B funding. Flat Capital led, joined by Industrifonden and Navigare Ventures.

deals.sector: Seychelles-based blockchain infrastructure startup
deals.note: Beldex , a Seychelles-based blockchain infrastructure startup, raised $8m. Sigma Capital led, joined by NTC, Nxgen, Digital Consensus Fund, and EAK Ventures.

deals.sector: Indian baby care e-commerce platform
deals.note: Peeko , an Indian baby care e-commerce platform, raised over $7m in Series A funding. Chiratae Ventures led, joined by Stellaris Venture Partners.

deals.sector: Seattle-based rock weathering startup
deals.note: Mafix , a Seattle-based rock weathering startup, raised $5.4m in pre-seed funding. Azolla Ventures led, joined by Counteract VC, Astera Institute, Plug and Play Ventures, and Impact Science Ventures.

deals.sector: British developer of ocean robotics
deals.note: Oshen , a British developer of ocean robotics, raised $5m. Lunar Ventures led, joined by AlbionVC, Twin Track, and Concept Ventures.

deals.sector: Swedish developer of photonic chips
deals.note: Solinide Photonics , a Swedish developer of photonic chips, raised €4m in seed funding. Navigare Ventures and PSV Hafnium led, joined by Chalmers Ventures, Turbine Capital, Norrsken Evolve, and Almi Greentech Fund.

deals.sector: Madison, Wis.-based developer of quantum positioning sensors
deals.note: Dirac Labs , a Madison, Wis.-based developer of quantum positioning sensors, raised $1.8m in pre-seed funding. TitletownTech led, joined by Automotive Ventures, Riceberg Ventures, and quantumEDGE Ventures.

deals.sector: Belgian learning platform for visual artists
deals.note: Artwod , a Belgian learning platform for visual artists, raised €1.1m in seed funding from Airbridge Equity Partners and ForsVC .

deals.sector: Lithuanian software training platform
deals.note: Guideless , a Lithuanian software training platform, raised €1m in pre-seed funding. Superhero Capital led, joined by Firstpick VC.
Arctos Partners agreed to buy a 10% stake in the NFL's Atlanta Falcons at a $10.6b enterprise value, per CNBC.

deals.company: Canada Growth Fund and Rice Investment Group
deals.note: Canada Growth Fund and Rice Investment Group invested $35m in EnerPure , a Canadian developer of motor oil recycling tech.
Certerra , backed by OceanSound Partners , acquired Skyrise Engineering and Testing , a Fort Lauderdale, Fla.-based geotechnical and materials testing firm.

KKR agreed to lead an A$7.7b takeover of Australian insurance broker Steadfast Group (ASX: SDF). As part of the deal, Genstar Capital -backed Amwins would acquire Steadfast's underwriting agency and Dragoneer would assume its broking business.
Long Ridge Equity Partners invested in MarketSphere , an Atlanta-based provider of unclaimed property compliance solutions.
Marquee Brands , owned by Neuberger Berman , acquired Roots ( TSX: ROOT), a Canadian outdoors and lifestyle brand, for C$4.10 per share.

deals.sector: enterprise AI consulting business launched by Anthropic and several PE firms
deals.note: Ode , the enterprise AI consulting business launched by Anthropic and several PE firms, acquired AI services firm Casper Studios .
Stone Point Capital acquired the risk management unit of agri-food tech company Ever.Ag .

deals.sector: Cincinnati-based portfolio company of Osceola Capital
deals.note: Valor Exterior Partners , a Cincinnati-based portfolio company of Osceola Capital , acquired Braintree, Mass.-based Associate Roofing .

deals.sector: GHK Capital portfolio company
deals.note: WSB , a GHK Capital portfolio company, acquired Civil Infrastructure Associates , a Murfreesboro, Tenn.-based municipal engineering firm.

deals.sector: Miami-based maker of in-space living and working structures, set Nasdaq float terms to 8.1m shares at $14-$17
deals.note: Gravitics , a Miami-based maker of in-space living and working structures, set Nasdaq float terms to 8.1m shares at $14-$17. It would have a $693m fully diluted value, were it to price in the middle. Shares currently trade OTC.

deals.sector: Melbourne, Fla.-based provider of excess and surplus home insurance
deals.note: Orion180 Insurance Group , a Melbourne, Fla.-based provider of excess and surplus home insurance, filed for a $100m IPO. It plans to list on the Nasdaq (OIG).

deals.company: SpaceX and AST SpaceMobile are among those interested in buying 800 MHz-band spectrum licenses held by Grain Management , per Bloomberg.
deals.note: SpaceX (Nasdaq: SPCX) and AST SpaceMobile (Nasdaq: ASTS) are among those interested in buying 800 MHz-band spectrum licenses held by Grain Management , per Bloomberg.
Continental Resources of Oklahoma agreed to buy a 50% stake in Phoenix Global Resources , an Argentinian shale oil firm owned by Mercuria Energy Group .
Holcim (Swiss: HOLN) agreed to acquire Fermacell , a German maker of sustainable walling and flooring solutions, for €430m from James Hardie Industries (NYSE: JHX).
Woody Johnson , owner of the woeful New York Jets, agreed to buy a minority stake in the Aston Martin Formula One team.
Mitsubishi Electric (Tokyo: 6503) agreed to acquire PCI Energy Solutions , a Norman, Okla.-based energy software provider, for $1.4b.

deals.company: Patrick Soon-Shiong said he doesn't plan to sell his 4% stake in the Los Angeles Lakers to the group led by Joshua Kushner and Bob Iger.

T. Rowe Price agreed to acquire F/m Investments , a fixed-income and ETF manager with around $19b.
WSP Global (TSX: WSP) plans to keep pursuing Arcadis , a listed Dutch engineering and consulting group that has rejected two unsolicited approaches.
Crestline Management of Texas raised $625m for its second Europe-focused PE fund.
Siguler Guff raised $500m for its latest India-focused fund.
SpaceX completed its $60 billion acquisition of Cursor, the largest acquisition ever of a VC-backed startup.
Stripe continued working with Advent International on a takeover of PayPal worth more than $50 billion.
